actions.name: ooze cube
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} have &Reference[Total Cover], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=EcTOfXWsDJRHLydy]] [[lookup @range.units activity=EcTOfXWsDJRHLydy]]. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can pull a creature or an object out of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} by succeeding on a [[/check dc=12 ability=str skill=ath format=long]], and the puller takes [[/damage average activity=PMCvyqxfUYiPzNK8]] damage.

actions.name: transparent
actions.desc: Even when the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a [[/check dc=15 ability=wis skill=prc format=long]] to notice the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} if the creature hasn't witnessed the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} move or otherwise act.

actions.name: engulf
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the @UUID[.mmOozeCube000000] trait). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=5o0Bh8PQaojx5XMx]], each creature whose space the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} enters for the first time during this move. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is &Reference[suffocating], can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition, and takes [[/damage average]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@abilities.str.dc]] check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Success: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.
